mapper.select: select a.*, g.name as goodsName from seckill_activity a left join goods g on a.goods_id = g.id where a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into seckill_activity(goods_id, seckill_price, total_stock, start_time, end_time, status, create_time) values(#{goodsId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{totalStock}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update seckill_activity set goods_id=#{goodsId}, seckill_price=#{seckillPrice}, total_stock=#{totalStock}, start_time=#{startTime}, end_time=#{endTime}, status=#{status} where id=#{id}
